<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via placedActions (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps), placedActions (literal, a string literal in PAGE_HEADER_PLACED_ACTIONS_BESIDE_LIST))_
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via placedActions (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps), placedActions (literal, a string literal in PAGE_HEADER_PLACED_ACTIONS_BESIDE_LIST))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via PageHeaderProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **169** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 140d8ce805dc55245d9841a6ece6dfb956d9e071` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7f3e4eadbbd9f1cfa03a29d5de1868f2847e8144` — the merge of head `371cb0fd9d323a0cc3c3b536831c10fab7ec78b4` into base `140d8ce805dc55245d9841a6ece6dfb956d9e071`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7f3e4eadbbd9f1cfa03a29d5de1868f2847e8144 && git checkout 7f3e4eadbbd9f1cfa03a29d5de1868f2847e8144
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 140d8ce805dc55245d9841a6ece6dfb956d9e071 371cb0fd9d323a0cc3c3b536831c10fab7ec78b4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 140d8ce805dc55245d9841a6ece6dfb956d9e071 && git merge --no-ff 371cb0fd9d323a0cc3c3b536831c10fab7ec78b4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 140d8ce805dc55245d9841a6ece6dfb956d9e071
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 140d8ce805dc55245d9841a6ece6dfb956d9e071` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `371cb0fd9d323a0cc3c3b536831c10fab7ec78b4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md + packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts, packages/spec/src/shared/refinement-projection.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts, packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs

Inputs read: card #30018 (body, the claim 6624302286, triage 6624681862, os-dev-report 6626669313), the ruling 6624172200 on #29951, PR #30028 (body, 12-file list, net diff `origin/main...371cb0fd`, merge-base `63b86b38`), and the check-runs on the head. The rest of the diff (changeset, docs, generated reference, `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, `liveness/page.json`, the two test files, the one `ui/` line) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read where the `hits` hunks make a claim about it, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set, `ui/PageHeaderProps`: widened by one key.** `placedActions: z.boolean().optional()`, no default. Right: on `main` the closed shape (`strictObject` → `closedObject(z.object(...).strict())`) refuses the key as unknown, so nothing that parsed before is refused now. The pair `placedActions: true` + `actions` moves from an `unrecognized_keys` refusal (rule `component-props-unknown-key`) to a `custom` refusal at `placedActions` (rule `component-props-invalid`); still refused, a different door, not a narrowing. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the right reading.
- **`placedActions: false` beside a list is accepted.** Right against the ruling: `false` asserts nothing the list does not, and refusing it would make the key a presence switch rather than a value switch.
- **No schema default.** Right, and load-bearing: `maxVisible` in the same shape records the rule (an unset key must stay unset so a parsed header does not become an authored one); the renderer on `main` (`PageHeaderRenderer`, `containers.tsx`) reads no `placedActions`, so a materialised `false` would be noise in every stored page.
- **Public surface: `authorable-surface/ui.json` +1 row `ui/PageHeaderProps:placedActions`.** Right; the generator enumerates `.shape`, which a zod 4 `.refine()` keeps (same-file precedent: `ElementButtonPropsSchema` is a `strictObject(...).refine(...)` chain, and the new describe-marker test reads `.shape.placedActions`).
- **Published JSON Schema `ui/PageHeaderProps` is wider than the runtime on the pair; ledger row `ui/PageHeaderProps` site `""` added, totals 250→251 / 1018→1019.** Right: the rule is value-conditional (`true` arms it). The closed list in `shared/refinement-projection.ts` has five arms (`required-one-of`, `non-blank-string`, `dependent-required`, `banned-keys`, `banned-key-pattern`); `dependent-required` is presence-only by its own docblock, and a presence-based "not both" would refuse `false` + list, which the runtime accepts, so no arm is exact. Dropped and annotated is the correct outcome, not a shortcut.
- **First consumer, `@objectstack/lint` `validateComponentProps`.** It safe-parses `ComponentPropsMap['page:header']` (the refined instance, pinned by the `toBe(PageHeaderProps)` test) and maps a non-`unrecognized_keys`, non-retired issue to `component-props-invalid` at `${base}.${issue.path}`, so the finding lands at `properties.placedActions` with the schema message. The lint test pins exactly that. Right.
- **Liveness.** No ledger row is possible (component-level keys sit under the undrilled `page/regions` container; `_note` on `main` says so for three earlier keys). The describe opens `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, which `check-liveness.mts` `MARKER_RE.planned` (`/\[planned|.../i`) reads as `planned`; the `_note` PLANNED RECORD names the carrier (#29951 ui half). The `Spec property liveness` check-run on the head is green. Right.
- **One `ui/` line.** `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS['page:header.placedActions']` in the console parity test books a spec key no registration input publishes; the key format matches the map's existing `type.key` entries. Within the ruling (spec half first; the ui half strikes it). Lane ACCEPT, noted here only because the liveness note cites it.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/30018-page-header-placed-actions.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/skills` minor, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` in both the PR body and the changeset. Matches what the diff publishes: a new authorable key on a published schema and a new authorable-surface row (`added` is required; the dev's `none` control exits 1 for that reason).
- `@objectstack/skills` minor rather than the `patch` that skills-only changesets on `main` carry: right here. `check-changeset-no-major` leg 3 counts `skills/**` as a file `@objectstack/skills`'s build copies into what it packs, and under a declared `Clause-②: yes` it refuses a moved package graded `patch`; the `patch` precedents are `Clause-②: no` PRs. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
- No 18.3.x note, per the maintainer amendment 「18.3.x 不发」; the card says the release note rides with the release that carries A. Right.
- `Clause-②:` line: `yes (widening)` — the PR body, the changeset and the diff agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none. Nothing to escalate from the dev.
- **Dev flag: the one `ui/` line.** Answered above: it is a test-ledger booking, not a renderer read, and the ruling's sequencing ("spec half first, then the ui reader") is exactly what makes it necessary. Accepted.
- **Dev flag: `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` line 101 lists `breadcrumb` on `page:header`.** Verified in the tree at `main`: the guide names `breadcrumb` in the title row, and `PageHeaderProps.breadcrumb` is a `retiredKey` tombstone the closed shape refuses (spec 17, ADR-0087 D2). Real, out of this card's scope, not blocking; it belongs on its own card. Escalated to the seat to file; the dev left it untouched, which is the right call.
- **Dev flag: `Skills-docs: follow-up #29951`.** Accepted: no renderer reads the key, so an eval that asks for `placedActions` would teach a key that draws nothing today. The existing eval `views-apps-actions-pages.json` still expects the declared action id in `properties.actions`, which the new catalogue row keeps as its first alternative.
- **Deviation: PR attribution links the card thread rather than the seat thread.** Bookkeeping; no effect on the tree.
- **Qualifier ledger for #29951.** The PR names six "not drawn yet" sites (describe marker, `_note` sentence, parity exemption, `pages.mdx`, `layout-dsl.mdx`, `pages.md`). Verified each is in the diff; the ui half must drop all six. Recorded here so the next card's reviewer can count them.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`** — judged against ruling 6624172200 letter A and the first consumer (`validateComponentProps`).

- Ruling A asks for one explicit opt-in on `page:header` that draws every action placed at `record_header` / `record_more`, read live, in place of an authored id list, with `actions` keeping its #11592 meaning, and spelling plus exclusivity as the seat's call, named in the PR. The tree delivers that: one boolean key `placedActions`; the describe states the live read and the two locations; the `actions` docblock and describe still say an authored list is the whole set and an omitted key draws none, now with the one addition "unless it sets `placedActions: true`"; the `.refine` refuses `true` beside a list (an empty list included: `[]` is "draw none" under #11592, which contradicts "draw every placed one"); the message names both keys and says keep one. The PR body's 维护者速读 names the spelling and the refusal, so the ruling's "named in the PR for the maintainer" condition is met.
- Tried to break it: (a) `placedActions: 'true'` + list: the type issue lands at `placedActions`, the predicate reads `=== true` so it adds nothing and cannot throw on a non-object payload (the refine runs on the parsed object). (b) `placedActions: true` + a retired key: the terminal unknown-key refusal of `closedObject` fires; the pair rule is moot. (c) A consumer calling `.extend` / `.pick` on `PageHeaderProps` would lose the check in zod 4; no consumer on `main` does (every use is `parse` / `safeParse`, plus `.shape` reads by the generators). (d) The refusal prose carries no tracker number (the docblock's ruling-record citation is a comment, not runtime text). (e) `defineStack` never parses `properties`, so the only doors are the lint rule and the page save door, both of which read `ComponentPropsMap`; the test that pins `ComponentPropsMap['page:header'] === PageHeaderProps` is what keeps the refine from being bypassed by a stale map entry.
- Design holds. No must-fix. No should-fix.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`** — judged against the card's eval (the skill's `views-apps-actions-pages.json` on `main`; the card itself names no eval) and the spec it teaches on `main`.

- The `page:header` catalogue row now reads `actions` (ids of the bound object's actions, never action nodes) or `placedActions: true` (all placed; not drawn yet). Against the spec on the head that is accurate on every clause: the two are exclusive ("or"), `true` is the spelling, and the qualifier matches the describe marker. The eval's expected output (the declared id in `properties.actions`, no sibling action node) is still what the row teaches first.
- The clause paid for the row, "and a `full` page with no regions" in the print paragraph, names a refusal the spec does make (`page.zod.ts` `checkPagePrintComposition`, "`print` needs the document's blocks in `regions`"). After the edit the paragraph still states the condition ("Only a `kind: 'full'` page ... with its blocks in `regions` may declare it"), and no eval pins the deleted clause; the ratchet has zero headroom on this file, so the trade is a fair one and leaves nothing untrue. Observation only, not a finding.
- Design holds. No must-fix. No should-fix.

**Check-runs on the head at the time of this record:** 24 success, 7 skipped, 0 failure, 31 in progress (Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core 1-8, Test UI 1-16, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Type Check · workspace). Completed and green include Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes, Build Docs, Build UI Deps and the scoped Lint / Type Check source-gate jobs. Nothing has concluded red. The verdict below is the contract verdict on the tree; the derived gates still running are the lane seat's merge condition.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#2 · head `371cb0fd9d323a0cc3c3b536831c10fab7ec78b4`

- **Shape:** `page:header` gains `placedActions: z.boolean().optional()` (no default). `true` draws every action of the bound object placed at `record_header` / `record_more`, read live; omitted or `false` leaves the authored `actions` list in charge with its #11592 meaning. `placedActions: true` beside an authored `actions` list (including `[]`) is refused at `properties.placedActions`, naming both keys; `false` beside a list is accepted. The key carries `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` until the ui reader lands (#29951). One `dropped-refinements` row (value-conditional rule), one `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` line in the ui registry-inputs parity test, docs and the `objectstack-ui` pages rule. 12 files, +230 −15.
- **Ruling:** A on #29951 (6624172200, maintainer 「以上同意」): one explicit opt-in, the list keeps its whole-set meaning, spelling and exclusivity are the spec seat's call. The seat's calls (`placedActions: true`; refused beside a list) are in the order and the PR body's 维护者速读; the one `ui/` test line is the seat's fork ruling A.
- **Contract review:** record 6626813985 (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `371cb0fd`, PASS, no must-fix, no should-fix).
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` minor + `@objectstack/skills` minor; `Skills-docs: follow-up #29951`. Nothing ships in 18.3.x for this (maintainer, 2026-11-04T06:24Z).
- **Gates:** every check-run on the head is complete: 58 success, 7 skipped, none red.
- **Handoff:** #29951's ui half strikes the exemption line and the six "not drawn yet" qualifiers the PR lists. Out-of-scope finding, to be filed separately: `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` still teaches the retired `page:header` key `breadcrumb`.
- **Landing:** ⛔ GOVERNED, Tier H. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` is on the register. The seat does not flip it ready or arm auto-merge. It waits for the maintainer's merge or an authorized APPROVED review (GOVERNED_APPROVERS); the seat then lands it.
